title: actor.register — Response
description: 201 Created on first call: returns BOTH `actor` and `token`. The plaintext `token` is shown exactly once. On idempotent replay (same operation_id + same request_hash) the response MUST OMIT the `token` field — only `actor` is returned. There is intentionally no token-recovery path: if a token is lost, an authenticated holder of an active credential MUST call actor.revoke_token and then actor.register a fresh actor. `token` is therefore not in `required`; conformant implementations enforce its presence on first call and its absence on replay via the paired fixtures (actor-register-happy and actor-register-operation-replay).

token.description: Opaque bearer credential. Returned ONLY on the first call for a given operation_id. Implementations MUST NOT return this field on idempotent replay. Implementations MUST NOT log or store this value in plaintext after returning it.
